Changelog

stabilityselectr 0.2.0

  • Bug fixes
    • fixed trapezoidal AUC calculation in the S3 summary() method; previous AUCs were incorrect (also affected the plot routine)
    • fixed integer x and y axes in plot_emp_fdr()
    • fixed unicode symbols in the S3 plot method via bquote(); previously failed during R CMD check
  • Reproducibility
    • reworked seed handling for multi-core runs
    • stability_selection() now sets the seed within mclapply(), as in stability_cluster() and progeny_cluster(); parallel and serial results now match
    • unit tests updated for the new seed behavior
  • Changes
    • modified default alpha and Pw in stability_selection() to match the docs
    • simplified FDRbound calculation in get_stable_features()
    • removed the scales dependency from the plot routine
    • cleaned up plot_emp_fdr(); fixed ggplot linewidth warning
    • cleaned up internal permutation checks
  • Docs
    • cleaned up examples, references, vignettes, and spelling; re-rendered README
  • CI
    • bumped GHA actions/checkout v3 -> v7
    • corrected GHA runner to macos-latest
